svg.title: Authentication and sealed (post-quantum encrypted) login
svg.desc: auth/ + crypto/. AuthHandler owns one RateLimiter per surface and issues HS384 JWT sessions. login / register / google_auth arrive sealed with a one-time ML-KEM-768 + X25519 key offered by SealedRegistry and signed by the server's ML-DSA-65 identity key.
svg.text: auth/ + crypto/. AuthHandler owns one RateLimiter per surface and issues HS384 JWT sessions. login / register / google_auth arrive
sealed with a one-time ML-KEM-768 + X25519 key offered by SealedRegistry and signed by the server's ML-DSA-65 identity key.
+ issue_session(db, signer, id, user, epoch, now) : SessionTokens
+ open(keys, nonce, aad, sealed, out&) : bool
Security rules visible in this design
- one-time keys: consume() deletes the key on first use
- the routing action is inside the encrypted payload,
so a sealed register cannot be replayed as login
<<interface>> = abstract class with only pure virtual methods; <<abstract>> = has some.
